title: The Looney Tunes Show
description: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the “Looney Tunes” characters are back with more adventures for a new generation of viewers. The animated series features roommates Bugs and Daffy moving out of the woods and into the suburbs, interacting with their neighbors, who happen to be other “Looney Tunes” favorites — including Sylvester, Tweety, Porky Pig and Foghorn Leghorn.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x1
episodes_data.description: Bugs and Daffy enter a game show that focuses on best friends, but Daffy's bottomless stupidity causes them to lose, which in turn causes him to try and be more like a friend to Bugs. But as expected, he tries way too hard.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x2
episodes_data.description: When Daffy realizes the country club is open to members only, he determines to gain access and take full advantage of all it offers. Bugs meets his dream girl: Lola Bunny.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x3
episodes_data.description: Daffy littering the Grand Canyon ultimately sends him and Bugs to jail, which Bugs grows a liking to, but Daffy hates. This causes some conflict when they get the chance to escape.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x4
episodes_data.description: Bugs and Daffy quickly discover that Yosemite Sam is a less-than-perfect houseguest when they are forced to take him in during a rainstorm. But how to get him to leave?

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x5
episodes_data.description: Daffy takes Gossamer under his wing, while Bugs stars in a TV commercial for Speedy's new frozen pizza. Plus, the Coyote attempts to capture the Road Runner using a zipline.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x6
episodes_data.description: When Daffy doesn't want to go to his class reunion because he feels he peaked in high school, Bugs tries to help him make something of himself before the big night.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x7
episodes_data.description: Instead of relaxing during a spa vacation, Bugs and Daffy spend most of their time fighting over a Hollywood starlet.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x8
episodes_data.description: When the Tasmanian Devil escapes from the local zoo and shows up on Bugs and Daffy's doorstep, Daffy is terrified. Bugs, however, thinks he's just a lost dog and adopts him.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x9
episodes_data.description: Foghorn Leghorn casts Daffy as himself in a movie about his life. Meanwhile, Bugs and Yosemite Sam find a potentially valuable vase buried in the backyard.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x10
episodes_data.description: Lola sweeps Bugs to Paris in an effort to fall in love and Daffy discovers that Granny was once a spy in World War II! The coyote tries to catch the Road Runner via speed skating.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x11
episodes_data.description: After learning about the invention that got Bugs rich, Daffy produces an improvement on it that ends up defective, sending him and Bugs into a financial crisis.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x12
episodes_data.description: Lola gives Daffy dating advice, and falls in love with him in the process. But Daffy only has eyes for Tina, and Bugs is surprised to find he might actually have feelings for Lola.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x13
episodes_data.description: Daffy has found some bowling friends: Marvin, Pete, and Porky. Bugs threatens to end that, which means problems when they enter a bowling tournament, which Bugs joins after Porky is hospitalized.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x14
episodes_data.description: Daffy has caused so much destruction in the neighborhood, that Bugs has thrown a dinner party so Daffy can say sorry. This won't be easy, as Daffy suspects one of the neighbors of newspaper thievery.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x15
episodes_data.description: Bugs gets a job alongside Porky at a boring office to cheer him up. Daffy also gets a job, but not one where he has to work. He gets a nose job.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x16
episodes_data.description: When Tina asks Daffy to babysit her nephew, Daffy discovers the unexpected joys of motherhood. Meanwhile, Bugs discovers how gullible Porky can be.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x17
episodes_data.description: When Bugs and Daffy's favorite pizza joint closes, Bugs reopens it ... and gets in way over his head.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x18
episodes_data.description: After they all get ticketed for moving violations, Daffy, Lola and Porky have to apply for new licenses at the Department of Motor Vehicles while Bugs can't get a lift home.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x19
episodes_data.description: Daffy takes on the persona of his television hero, Steve St. James, while Bugs takes on his caffeine addiction, by switching to energy drinks.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x20
episodes_data.description: When Foghorn Leghorn takes a liking to Daffy he makes him the CEO of his company ... with disastrous results.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x21
episodes_data.description: A plate of French fries threatens to ruin Daffy and Porky's friendship, as well as Bugs' chance to see a playoff game. Plus, Lola sings about her favorite holiday of the year.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x22
episodes_data.description: Daffy helps Tina earn her cosmetology license, while Bugs helps Porky learn to dance. Plus, Daffy explains the meaning of love to Porky.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x23
episodes_data.description: After a car wash accident on his parade float, Daffy swindles Porky out of all his savings in order to obtain a yacht to replace the parade float. Plus, the Gophers sing about what makes them best friends ... to a Bossa Nova beat.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x24
episodes_data.description: Bugs tries to hang a shelf to display his Nobel Prize, but the project gets complicated. Daffy explains to Porky why a birthday gift was "chintzy."

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x25
episodes_data.description: Daffy suspects that Porky is a killer, and Bugs has to take care of Lola when she breaks her leg.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 1x26
episodes_data.description: Sylvester becomes obsessed with a laser toy. The Coyote orders the ultimate trap, and actually catches the Road Runner ... now if he could just get him out!

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x1
episodes_data.description: Daffy coaches Gossamer’s water polo team despite having no experience. Meanwhile, Bugs becomes addicted to Porky’s unhealthy, butter-loaded catering.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x2
episodes_data.description: Daffy accidentally emails a letter to everyone he knows explaining what’s wrong with them and must suffer the consequences. Lola and her parents want Bugs in their family photo.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x3
episodes_data.description: When one of the Gophers is reported missing, Daffy and Lola take the case to look for him. Meanwhile, Bugs nearly destroys his home trying to kill a spider.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Bugs loses his gloves, the motorcycle gloves he gets as a replacement lead him to the life of a rebel. Meanwhile, Daffy is accidentally hired as a college professor.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x5
episodes_data.description: When Bugs tells a small lie to Porky, it gathers steam to make everything far worse — it even prompts Daffy to join the U.S. Marines.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x6
episodes_data.description: Volunteering in the Father Figure program, Porky is matched up with the troubled Henry Hawk and Foghorn is paired up with Daffy, who may have lied about his age. Meanwhile, Bugs and Walter train for a tennis match.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Cecil Turtle, a customer service representative, intentionally cuts off Bugs’ cable TV, Bugs declares war. Meanwhile, Daffy tries to get a job as a customer service representative supervisor.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x8
episodes_data.description: Porky decides to run a marathon, threatening Daffy’s definition of everyone’s roles in their circle of friends. Meanwhile, Yosemite Sam wants to save Bugs' life because Bugs saved his.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x9
episodes_data.description: Daffy’s world is turned upside-down when his handbag is stolen at the mall, prompting him to hire Porky as his full-time bodyguard. Lola searches the globe for the anniversary gift for Bugs.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x10
episodes_data.description: When the overwhelming heat zaps everyone's enthusiasm for Christmas, Lola decides to stage her own version of A Christmas Carol to renew the town's holiday spirit, while Foghorn and Daffy set off for the North Pole to set up a giant fan that will blow cold air down to their sweltering town.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x11
episodes_data.description: While babysitting, Lola reads a spell book as a bedtime story to Gossamer and turns him into a frog. Meanwhile, a get-rich-quick scheme gets Daffy and Porky attacked by a giant bear.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x12
episodes_data.description: Lola joins a monastery and Bugs buys a boat to sail around the world when they each mistakenly believe the other has ended their relationship. Meanwhile, Daffy runs against Porky for City Council.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x13
episodes_data.description: When Tina’s dad comes to town, Daffy decides to pretend he is a lawyer in order to impress him. Bugs must pretend to be Daffy’s slacker roommate.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x14
episodes_data.description: Daffy and Porky attend a self-help seminar, which inspires Daffy to want to learn how to fly. When that doesn’t work, he settles for becoming an airline flight attendant.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x15
episodes_data.description: Daffy drags Porky along on spring break when nobody else will go with him and the two quickly end up in jail in a small town in Mexico.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x16
episodes_data.description: Tensions flare when Bugs and Porky start a business together selling carrot cake. Daffy decides to become an actor in commercials since it is easy, high-paying work.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x17
episodes_data.description: Daffy must shake an online shopping addiction when he uses Bugs’ computer to do his online shopping. Daffy is dragged by Yosemite Sam into a group therapy. Bugs is addicted to a video game called Gribbler’s Quest.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x18
episodes_data.description: Daffy takes piano lessons from Granny. As a result, Bugs gets noise-cancelling earbuds and quickly realizes he can tune out everything.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x19
episodes_data.description: After accidentally getting shipped to Alaska, the Tasmanian Devil, Tweety and Sylvester must put aside their differences and make an incredible journey together to return to their happy homes.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x20
episodes_data.description: Cecil Turtle returns with a broken shell scam that he uses to con Bugs out of money. Meanwhile, when Daffy’s beloved recliner breaks, he and Lola search for a replacement.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x21
episodes_data.description: Daffy is highly insulted when he discovers that ducks are not included in the Chinese zodiac, and attempt to make ducks more popular.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x22
episodes_data.description: Daffy becomes campaign manager for Gossamer’s run for Class President. Porky moves in with Bugs and Daffy after his catering business goes broke, and spends his days reorganizing everything.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x23
episodes_data.description: Daffy convinces Porky that they should go on a road trip to Porky’s third grade girlfriend’s wedding in an attempt to win her back after all these years.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x24
episodes_data.description: Daffy enters a hot dog eating contest to try and win the title “Mr. Weiner” and Bugs gets roped into helping Yosemite Sam attempt to jump a school bus over a row of motorcycles.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x25
episodes_data.description: When Bugs meets up with a old friend named Rodney Rabbit, Daffy gets jealous and uses the time vortex at Witch Lezah's to go back in time and ensure Bugs and Rodney never become friends. Meanwhile, Porky Pig wonders about his ranking in Daffy Duck's list of best friends.

episodes_data.title: The Looney Tunes Show 2x26
episodes_data.description: Bugs tells the story of SuperRabbit, with himself as SuperRabbit, Elmer Fudd as Lex Luthor, and Daffy as Zod, and explains why he gave up the SuperLife.
